harvest_span_days.quote: Rabi season, that is, November–December, is the best time for harvesting tuberous roots
harvest_span_days.note: November-December: about a month or two of digging; 30 days used.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The crop, when harvested in 12 months, yields about 4–5 tonnes/hectare

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The tuberous root yields 10%–12% of dry matter after removal of outer wall.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: 4 t/ha x 10% = 0.4 t/ha of dried root = 0.04 kg/m². The dried-root price below is for dry root.

economics.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
economics.quote: An average shade-dried tuberous root yield of 3 tonnes per hectare is obtained from 20-month-old plants underexperimental conditions.
economics.note: Waiting 20 months gives far more dried root (3 t/ha, experimental) but ties the bed up for nearly two years.

economics.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
economics.quote: The calculated yield of 20 month-old crop of Shatavar is 3 tonnes/hectare, which can fetch net returns of approximately Rs 62,500 /hectare.
economics.note: The source's own estimate, at the price it assumed; the cost of cultivation it gives is about Rs 1,00,000 per hectare.

source_notes: AI research batch 15 (2026-10-08), medicinal and ayurvedic crops. Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Yields are of the dried product that is sold (dried root, leaf or seed) unless a note says fresh. Sowing dates are from national guides (region india) unless a Malwa study is named. Medicinal crops are planned only when the owner picks the medicinal method; the market for each is thin and buy-back is not assured (see the economics sources).
